title: 蛇没有腿怎么走
subtitle: 靠鳞片和肌肉一推一推
character: wearing a moss green sweatshirt, dark grey trousers and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, fine pen lines with light transparent watercolour washes, moss green, warm grey and soft amber

pages.zh:
玻璃箱里那条蛇
一动起来就往前溜。
它一条腿也没有，
我盯着看了半天，
还是没看出门道。
pages.scene: A head-and-shoulders portrait of the little boy crouching in front of a glass tank, only his head and shoulders inside the picture and everything below his chest outside the frame, his face turned straight towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, puzzled; a green snake glides across the sand behind the glass.

pages.zh:
爸爸让我看它肚子。
肚皮上有一排鳞，
一片挨着一片，
横着排过去，
从脖子排到尾巴。

这排鳞又宽又扁，
每一片的后边
都翘起来一点点。
往前推的时候不费劲，
往后就勾住地面。
pages.scene: Close view of a snake's underside on a cream background, one row of wide flat belly scales running along it, each scale's back edge lifted a little. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以它一使劲，
鳞片就勾住地面，
身子被推着往前。
勾一下，走一点，
一推一推地往前走。

最常见的走法
是把身子弯成波浪，
一边一边地弯。
每个弯的外边
都在使劲蹬着地。
pages.scene: One snake moving through short grass on a cream background, its body bent into a wave, pressing against small stones on the outside of each bend. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
身子弯不是白弯的。
一个弯推一下，
一个弯又推一下，
像一道浪从头上
一直传到尾巴尖。

它还会直着往前走。
身子一点也不弯，
肚皮底下的鳞片
一片一片往后拨，
像许多只小脚。
pages.scene: One snake moving straight forward along a fallen log on a cream background, its body held in a straight line. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它的骨头也多。
我们只有二十四根肋骨，
它有好几百根，
一根连着一根，
所以怎么弯都行。

可它怕光溜的地方。
把它放到玻璃上，
鳞片勾不住东西，
使多大的劲
也挪不了几步。
pages.scene: One snake lying on a wide sheet of smooth polished stone on a cream background, its body bent but going nowhere. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
沙漠里的蛇
还有另一种走法：
身子斜着甩出去，
一段一段落下，
沙上留下一排斜道。

爬树的时候呢，
它先绕住树干，
一圈一圈地箍紧，
再一节一节地
把自己一点点往上挪。
pages.scene: One snake wound around a rough tree trunk on a cream background, gripping it tightly as it works its way upward. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我趴在玻璃跟前
看它肚皮底下。
那排鳞真的在动，
一片接着一片，
把它推着往前走。
pages.scene: A head-and-shoulders portrait of the little boy lying on the floor with his chin near the glass tank, only his head and shoulders inside the picture and everything below his chest outside the frame, his face turned straight towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, absorbed; the green snake moves past on the other side.
